title: getJob request
description: GET /v1/jobs/{jobId} - request. Progress and counters of a fan-out job (FanOutStatusQuery).
$comment: Source: DISENO S4 (b), (d) StartFanOutUseCase/CancelFanOutUseCase/FanOutStatusQuery, (e) operator APIs (RF-121), AP-F6, AP-F7; PRD RF-121, RF-022; US-08.2.1. Audience: OPERATOR (operator console / role-restricted). Residency: REGIONAL (cell); job view is OPERATIONAL (counters, no engagement ids). Idempotency: safe read (GET). Pagination: none (single resource).

headers.description: Contract-relevant request headers (platform/transport headers are out of scope). correlation-id is optional from the UI (generated by ms-experience-gateway when missing, DISENO 3.8.5) and mandatory on service-to-service and operator calls (propagation, RF-120).

jobId.description: Job id (= publishId for a publish).
